field.label: Enable Proxy Gateway
field.help: Enable or disable the Proxy Gateway service globally.

field.label: Start connections on boot
field.help: Automatically start all enabled connections when the system boots. When disabled, connections must be started manually via the Apply button.

field.label: Auto-reconnect (Watchdog)
field.help: Automatically restart crashed tun2socks connections. The watchdog checks every 60 seconds and restarts any enabled connection whose process has died.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Default log level for all proxy gateway connections.

field.label: Enable Speed Test
field.help: Periodically measure download throughput through each proxy connection. Results shown on the Diagnostics page. Note: each test downloads a file through the proxy, consuming bandwidth.

field.label: Test Interval
field.help: How often to run speed tests for each connection. Shorter intervals provide more data but use more bandwidth.

field.label: Test File Size
field.help: Size of the test download. Larger files give more accurate results but take longer and use more bandwidth. Estimated daily usage per connection: 1MB=96MB, 5MB=480MB, 10MB=960MB, 25MB=2.4GB (at 15min interval).

field.label: Auto Force-Down Gateway
field.help: Automatically set the gateway to "force down" when the proxy health check fails repeatedly. This removes the gateway from the routing table, preventing traffic blackholes. When using a backup proxy, the failover happens before force-down.
